evidence.reason: At the current tip, the `_committed_probe_repo` Git helper still invokes `subprocess.run(..., cwd=repo)` without an `env`, so inherited `GIT_DIR`, `GIT_INDEX_FILE`, or `GIT_WORK_TREE` can redirect `git init/add/commit/rev-parse` away from the fixture repository. `_run_probe_cli` likewise inherits the caller's Git environment. This is a genuine test-isolation defect, though minor because ordinary shell runs without those overrides are unaffected.
